test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As of April 2021, the ________ India scheme aims at providing people belonging to the scheduled caste or scheduled tribe or women of the country a loan between ₹10 lakhs to ₹1 crore, based on their requirement to promote entrepreneurship, which has been extended up to the year 2025.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Stand-up**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Stand-up India** scheme aims at providing people belonging to the scheduled caste or scheduled tribe or women of the country a loan between ₹10 lakhs to ₹1 crore.
 
• The scheme is designed to promote entrepreneurship among SC/ST and women, thereby encouraging them to start their own businesses.
 
• As of April 2021, the scheme has been extended up to the year 2025.
 
• The loans under this scheme are intended to help new entrepreneurs start greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or the trading sector.
 
• The scheme also offers support through the SIDBI (Small Industries Development Bank of India) for credit needs and other handholding services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Stand-up India** scheme was launched by the Government of India on 5th April 2016.
 
• The scheme aims to facilitate bank loans between ₹10 lakhs and ₹1 crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
 
• The scheme is implemented through all Scheduled Commercial Banks in India.
 
• It is part of the broader financial inclusion strategy to ensure that the underrepresented groups get access to formal credit and contribute to economic growth.

135:T1
